exclusion_detail: Lead 12a needs 5 reactions as the paper describes them: (1) 2,4-thiazolidinedione from chloroacetic acid + thiourea (procedure given in 3.1.2.1), (2) Knoevenagel with 2-hydroxybenzaldehyde giving 5a, (3) 4-((4,6-dichloro-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl)amino)benzonitrile (8) from cyanuric chloride + 4-aminobenzonitrile, (4) 9a from 8 + 5a, (5) 12a from 9a + 2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethanol. Even if thiazolidinedione were bought it would be 4 plus an unlisted 9a heading, so the count is 5 by the brief's rule.

lead.label: 12a
lead.why: Abstract: 'Compounds 12a was identified as prospective lead compound against HIV-1 ... Compound 12a was found effective against HIV-1 in a cell-based experiment ... therapeutic index of 113 and an EC50 of 125.1 nM'.

notes: The di-substituted series 10a-e (TZD prep, Knoevenagel, 8, 9, NH3 amination) is also 5 steps, and every intermediate 9 needs the same chain, so no compound of the paper is within 4 steps. Step 3 text prints a nonsensical quantity for cyanuric chloride ('5.0 g, mol'). The 9a intermediate has no heading of its own, only the general procedure.
